people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

people.name: Meunites
people.line: A people group who were enemies of Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
translations.bsb: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war against Jehoshaphat.
translations.kjv: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after this, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
